description: BC Dams is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are Canada, dam, water licensing, water management, water rights. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
